I will not put chemical fertilizer on this bean plot because beans usually manage without it, and I have to watch my money across all my land. I will use some manure if I can get enough, plant my usual local seed, and depend on rain because we do not irrigate here. My family will do most of the work on this small plot, and I may only hire a little help if needed at peak time.
